name: R082-clefable-metronome-mud-sport-twice
why: Challenge 7. The player's Clefable (389, Metronome 10 PP) calls Metronome 10 times in a row opposite Shuckle (528: Sandstorm, Dig, Flash, Double Team; Attack 10, so it cannot knock Clefable out); every call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336 each). After the tenth call the script switches to Salamence (753) and plays Aerial Ace (slot 2; it never misses, so a Double Team stack cannot stall the end; luck6). Mud Sport or Water Sport called twice (the second fails: STATUS3_MUDSPORT / WATERSPORT already set on the user). Chance per seed about C(10,2) x 2/336^2 = 0.08%.
